title: USP Profile
description: Defines the structure of USP profile documents. A profile is a machine-readable JSON document that declares a participant's USP capabilities and configuration. Businesses publish a BusinessProfile at /.well-known/usp; platforms publish a PlatformProfile at a stable URI they advertise via the USP-Agent header (REST) or _meta.usp.profile field (MCP). See $defs/BusinessProfile and $defs/PlatformProfile.

SigningKey.title: SigningKey
SigningKey.description: A public key in JWK format (RFC 7517) used to verify HTTP Message Signatures (RFC 9421) on webhook payloads sent by the profile publisher. The keyid parameter in the Signature-Input header of a webhook MUST match the kid of one of these keys.

kid.description: Key ID. Referenced in the Signature-Input header's keyid parameter to identify which key was used to sign a webhook payload.

crv.description: Elliptic curve name. REQUIRED when kty is EC.

x.description: X coordinate in base64url encoding (RFC 4648). REQUIRED for EC keys.

y.description: Y coordinate in base64url encoding (RFC 4648). REQUIRED for EC keys.

n.description: RSA modulus in base64url encoding. REQUIRED for RSA keys.

e.description: RSA public exponent in base64url encoding. REQUIRED for RSA keys.

use.description: Intended key usage. SHOULD be set to sig for webhook verification keys.

alg.description: Algorithm intended for use with this key. ES256 (ECDSA P-256 + SHA-256) is RECOMMENDED. Implementations MUST support ES256. ES384 and RS256 are OPTIONAL.

BusinessProfile.title: BusinessProfile
BusinessProfile.description: A USP business profile document. MUST be published at /.well-known/usp over HTTPS with no redirects and with Cache-Control: public, max-age>=60. Describes the scheduling endpoints, capabilities, payment support, business identity, and (optionally) webhook signing keys of a USP-enabled business.

usp.description: The USP metadata object. Contains version, services endpoint registry, capabilities registry, optional checkout_systems, business identity, and optional backward-compatibility declarations.

signing_keys.description: CONDITIONAL. Public keys for verifying webhook signatures. MUST be present when the business sends signed webhook payloads. Multiple keys MUST be supported to enable zero-downtime key rotation. The business SHOULD publish a new key before switching to it, and SHOULD retain the old key for at least 24 hours after rotation.

PlatformProfile.title: PlatformProfile
PlatformProfile.description: A USP platform profile document. Published at a stable URI that the platform advertises on every USP API request via the USP-Agent HTTP header (REST binding) or the _meta.usp.profile field (MCP binding). Describes the capabilities and service preferences of the platform, enables businesses to perform server-side capability negotiation without round-trip negotiation messages, and optionally provides webhook callback URLs and request signing keys.

usp.description: The USP metadata object. Contains version and capabilities registry. Optionally includes service consumption preferences.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS callback URL where the business should deliver webhook notifications (booking lifecycle events). Businesses MUST deliver webhooks to this URL when registered. See §9.2.3 and §10.1.1.

signing_keys.description: CONDITIONAL. Public keys for verifying HTTP Message Signatures (RFC 9421) on platform REST requests. SHOULD be present when the platform signs state-modifying requests. Multiple keys MUST be supported for zero-downtime key rotation. See §9.1.4.
